answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36410 Country: India Title: If offering fardh of Fajr (Qadha) is done before Zuhr should it be included offering of the Sunnat-e-Muakkadah or not Question: If offering fardh of Fajr (Qadha) is done before Zuhr should it be included offering of the Sunnat-e-Muakkadah or not? Is offering Witr (Qadha) compulsory, and how many rakahs should be offered? Answer ID: 36410 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 268/151/D=1433) (1) No. Sunnah shall not be offered after zawal, only fardh shall be offered. (2) Yes, the qaza of witr is necessary. It shall be offered three raka’ah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
